steps.content: You push the door to the interrogation room and find the survivor of the crypt sitting on a chair. She is fiddling with her handcuffs while trying to get a good look at the papers on your desk.
One of the handcuffs had long been removed by her.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Come on, take it easy! Roulecca didn't do anything, Roulecca just wanted to take a look around!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Maybe I'm just too lucky? This handcuff just came off by itself!
The fact that the Sinner restraint falls off for no apparent reason makes you on alert.
You prepare to use shackles to prevent Roulecca from turning against you.
But she shows no fluctuation in her emotions and does not activate her ability.
She just looks at you, curious and excited.
Exactly the same as the young face you saw in the profile photo before entering the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, please be fully prepared for this interrogation.
Why?
You put down her profile and asked.
She doesn't seem like a particularly dangerous Sinner.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I've investigated Roulecca and found how "baffling" her ability was.
Nightingale hands the files to you.
On **/**/****, Roulecca played roulette at x Casino in Eastside for 3 hours and won 13 million DisCoins. She also fought off the gangsters who came to give her trouble with only a revolver.
On XX/XX/XXXX, Roulecca planned an explosion at the x block in Syndicate after winning a roulette game. Roulecca was less than five meters away from the root of the explosion but came out unharmed.
On **/**/****, Roulecca's gang, Four-leaf Clover, was wiped out in a sneak attack from other gangs. Roulecca was the only survivor.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Indeed. The FAC's follow-up investigation confirmed that luck was her special ability as a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Her combat skills are excellent, and she never minds risking her life in fighting. There is a high probability that she is the "mastermind" behind the crypt incident.
The word "roulette" appearing so frequently in the files catches your attention.
Is this roulette... something she does for fun?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's a life-risking game. Sometimes, instead of killing her enemies, she'd let them play weird games with her. And such games usually include the use of a revolver.
Did the FAC give any guidelines about safety?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Be 100% prepared against her abilities.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hey, Chief? Chief! How come you froze there just now? Were you fascinated by Roulecca?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: We're just going to play a game. There's no need to be that nervous.

options: What about the info you're going to tell?

choices.text: What about the info you're going to tell?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Yep! Hmm, let's play... Truth or Dare!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You know, the kind of game where the winner can ask the other person a question.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Have you played it before, Chief?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oh, I forgot to tell you, Chief. You'll have to win Roulecca to make me admit defeat with grace.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Only then will you get the information from Roulecca.
What are we playing?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm, Roulecca is thinking... How about Truth or Dare? Have you played it before, Chief?
I have, but only a few times.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ah, that's perfect! But don't think you can win Roulecca just because you've played it before, Chief! There will be a few changes to the rules this time!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ah, I guess you don't have many friends, Chief. Don't worry, though. Roulecca will play with you this time.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But compared to the standard Truth or Dare, there will be a few more rules!
Roulecca suddenly shows a sly smile. You instinctively feel that it isn't going to be as simple as "a few."

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Find a revolver, just like the ones I usually use. The gun has six bullet slots but you'll put only one bullet in it.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Then we'll take turns shooting ourselves in the head until we hear a bang.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: The winner will be decided when one of us gives up or dies. Really old-school game. Roulecca likes it a lot.

options: Is this really Truth or Dare?
Are you sure this isn't some other game?

choices.text: Is this really Truth or Dare?
Are you sure this isn't some other game?

steps.content: This is exactly the "roulette game" mentioned in the files!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oh, Chief! It's just Truth or Dare with a little flavor added to it!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Of course, for every shot, the person who shoots will have the privilege of asking one question. No matter what it is, the other person must answer!
Any kind of question?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: No matter how private your question is, Chief, Roulecca will answer you truthfully.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I mean, Chief, you were able to catch Roulecca, so maybe you have better luck. Perhaps...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Perhaps you will be able to live and ask all your questions, then finally shoot Roulecca dead in the interrogation room! Ohhhh, this sounds so exciting!
Given her luck, you're afraid that you will die if you play with her.
But fortunately, you took Nightingale's advice and are well-prepared for this game.
So you decide that...
Alright, let's do it.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Yay! Roulecca knew that Chief is the best! Let's get started right away!
But you must stay true to your words. Promise?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Of course! Roulecca always keeps promises! But don't you try to play any tricks, Chief.
After a brief wait, the gun requested by Roulecca is delivered to the interrogation room.
You hand the pistol to Roulecca for inspection.
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Wow, so quickly.
She turns over the revolver several times before giving it a final spin. Satisfied, she puts the revolver back in your hand.
You open the cylinder and insert a single bullet.
The cylinder spins with a clicking sound, making you look like a cowboy from centuries prior. Roulecca even whistles at you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Not bad, Chief! But don't forget to stay away from me when the time comes.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: The firepower of a .45 is very powerful, and it could pose a problem if you get my clothes stained... Hehe.
Roulecca is arrogant and provocative. Yet she has her asset to be so.
Who's going to fire first?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Do you want to flip a coin to decide who shoots first, Chief? Or, I don't mind if you want to go first.
Roulecca takes a DisCoin out of nowhere.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Alright... This is Roulecca's 33rd favorite game! Hmm, let's go with heads for Roulecca first and tails for Chief first.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm... I think a new player deserves more chances. Why don't you go first, Chief?
No need to go easy on me. Let's begin.
Roulecca shakes her head and tosses the coin into the air.
It spins several times before bouncing off the table with a clinking sound. When you almost think it'll end up with heads, it bizarrely turns over in the last second.
It's tails. You repeatedly check under the desk for things like magnets but find nothing.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I told you! Nobody can beat Roulecca's luck! Fire the shot, Chief!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm, fine. Since it was your first time playing, Chief, Roulecca was going to go easy on you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But I never thought you would be so impatient...
It is said that the brave will be favored by the god of luck.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Haha, yes, Roulecca has heard of that saying. But it's merely the boasting of those who survived.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: The unlucky "brave" end up being corpses that cannot speak anymore.
The cold muzzle is pushed against the temple. You may be well-prepared, but you still feel a sense of discomfort.
(Clack)
The cylinder lets out an empty sound. A miss. You can hear Roulecca applauding from the other side.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Wow, amazing! Roulecca was worried you would be out in the first round, Chief but you're awesome!
It does not sound like a compliment, but you pay no mind to it and ask your first question.

options: Why were you in the crypt?

choices.text: Why were you in the crypt?

steps.content: To resolve the problem in the quickest manner and reduce risk, you ask the most important question first.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm, why do you start with such a difficult question?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Let's make this question your reward for winning the whole thing, okay? Roulecca will allow you to change your question, Chief!
Roulecca seems to be avoiding your question deliberately. Looks like she is also prepared.

options: So what else do you know about the crypt?

choices.text: So what else do you know about the crypt?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm, this is also quite direct, Chief... But to show that Roulecca is a woman of her word, I will answer your question this time!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Let Roulecca think for a bit...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oh, right! Roulecca had just finished eating dinner and was strolling there. And then, Roulecca suddenly heard gunshots coming out of that crypt-like place.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: When I was about to go down, I saw a group of people from the Legion coming out, so I hid away at once. I thought I could enter when they were gone. And then... then Roulecca ran into you, Chief!
That's it?
Do you really not know anything apart from that? Like what was inside this crypt?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: No idea! It really was the first time Roulecca went there!
Strange. Intel suggests she is related to the organization in the crypt. However, she doesn't seem to be lying as she does not know about the mania weapons underground or the coffin.
In that case, she should not be the commander of those underground gangsters. If she were, how could she be so laid-back after losing so many men and weapons?
But you don't dare to assume anything and decide to ask for more details.
So you are affiliated with...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: No, Chief. Only the winner can continue asking questions. Besides... Roulecca has a lot to ask you, Chief.
Without waiting for you to return the pistol, she makes an effort to lean forward. She takes the pistol, points it at her temple, and pulls the trigger.
Naturally, nothing happens. But she does not give you back the pistol right away.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Now, it's your turn to answer Roulecca's question, Chief. What exactly happened in the crypt?
They were seeking the mania weapons underground but could not withstand the contamination and became monsters.
So we wiped them out, nice and simple.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahahahaha... Hahahah!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: That's so funny! Hahahah... They were so lame, right, Chief?
Roulecca laughs happily.
They got what was coming to them.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Okay.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: It's your turn, Chief. Make sure you play a couple more rounds.
It may be a misperception, but you sense a hint of loneliness in her words. You do not respond and take the pistol she hands over.
You pull the trigger. (Click)
Another miss. It's time to ask another question.

options: What organization are you affiliated with?

choices.text: What organization are you affiliated with?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Umm, Four-leaf Clover, I guess.
Not The Homeless?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I see myself as the leader of Four-leaf Clover rather than that of The Homeless.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
Do you really think one person can be considered a gang?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Whoa, you sure did your homework! You even know Roulecca is the only member left in Four-leaf Clover!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Let me guess... Is this interrogation room also specially prepared for Roulecca?
Sorry, but this is necessary for security reasons.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sigh... It takes me back. Back then, Roulecca always got into trouble, be it blowing up the wall or tearing down the door. So Dad had to change everything at home to ones made of iron.
Didn't anyone in the gang hate you for this?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: This should've been considered a question. However, Roulecca really like it, so this will be a freebie.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Nobody in Four-leaf Clover hated Roulecca! Growing up, Roulecca has always been loved by everyone in the gang. Even if made any trouble, I'd just need to pout to get away with it.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: By the way, let me tell you a SUPER IMPORTANT piece of information!
I'm all ears.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Guess what? Roulecca's ability came from being spoiled by everyone!

options: Feels a bit more creative than a fairy tale.

choices.text: Feels a bit more creative than a fairy tale.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: What?! How cold! Roulecca's getting angry! Hand over the gun!
She takes the pistol and points it at herself before fiercely pulling the trigger.
(Clack)
Just like before, nothing happened.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: It's Roulecca's turn to ask a question. Where did the mania weapons come from?
Now you're certain that she's not the leader of the gangs in the crypt, but she is curious to know more about the gangs.
Is there something going on between her and the gangsters?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Cat got your tongue, Chief? Is this question too difficult?
The crypt was the depot that stored the mania weapons, which lured in the gangsters.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oh? Roulecca has never heard of any gangs selling mania weapons. Can you tell Roulecca who sold them to the gangsters?
It doesn't matter who sold them.
Everything was destroyed by the Legion, Everything—the gangsters or the Mania weapons—was destroyed by the Legion.
The Legion has saved the Syndicate and everything has been drawn to a close.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Legion... it's the Legion again.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sigh... Always one step behind. How unfortunate.
Roulecca slowly sighs and looks unsatisfied with your answer.
But when looking over at the revolver, she starts to smile excitedly again. She slowly raises the gun towards you as if she is handing it to you or about to shoot you.
You silently take the gun and point it against your temple.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Roulecca bursts into laughter.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Never thought there would be a dummy like you. The fifth shot, huh... It's the first time I was this satisfied! I really like you, Chief. You're the best!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: So, just shoot at your shoulder or somewhere else. Roulecca does not want to see your brains.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: After all, you're the only one who has played with me for this long.
You smile at her. You are not afraid because you have already done the preparations.
The revolver is real, but you doctored the bullets. Nobody will get hurt.
You have tricked Roulecca, though playing a game of luck against someone like her could not be considered fair in the first place.
Everything is for the sake of the truth. She's clearly also trying to get some kind of information out of you. You might as well impress her.
No need. To play a game, you must be able to afford to lose.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Really?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: What a shame...
Roulecca looks at you with a smile while slamming her right hand against her chair. You hear the sound of something being unlocked.
She leisurely leans down and pulls out an identical revolver from under the chair.
While you are dumbfounded, she fires four shots in a row towards the air. On the fifth, the barrel pops out a bunch of colorful glitter that slowly flutters to the ground.
The gun in her hand is the one that was doctored.
So, how about the gun in your hand?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Watch out. The gun in your hand has real bullets.
Just how did this unpredictable girl bring a real gun into the interrogation room? When did she swap the guns?
A fifty percent chance that the .45 round will blow out your skull and turn your brain into mush. And your opponent is a crazy gambler with sheer luck.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Now you finally look like you're nervous, Chief. Although your acting was quite good, it lacked a little bit of oomph.
A drop of cold sweat slides down your spine. Is there really a need to continue?
(Clack )
The moment you hear the trigger snap into the cylinder, your heart stops for a moment.
It's empty.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Haha... hahahaha, hahahahahahaha! Interesting, how interesting!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: This is the first time someone has beaten me. Is it because of those shackles?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ahhh, it doesn't matter. A win is a win. Roulecca admits defeat!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: This time, Roulecca is answering the question that you asked at the beginning, Chief!
I concede. People are dying every day in the DisCity but it shouldn't be me nor you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Tsk, boring! We were so close to the end!
You place the pistol on the desk, intending to ask the guards to take this weapon away.
The moment you look up, you find Roulecca picking up the gun.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: If you can't make up your mind, Chief, then Roulecca shall decide for you!
(Clack )
Before you can react, you hear the sound of the trigger snap into the cylinder.
Luckily, it was an empty shot.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Haha... hahahaha, hahahahahahaha! Interesting, how interesting!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: This is the first time someone has won against Roulecca! The gun... It, it didn't fire!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Roulecca admits defeat. Now, the very first question you asked, Chief.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But before answering, you need to answer one little question.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Did you already guess why Roulecca was there, Chief?
All I know is that you have no relation with the gangs and are not their leader.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmph, you say you don't know but you've already guessed pretty much everything.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: However, you did not get the most important thing right.
You and they crossed paths but that doesn't mean it must be a mutual trading relationship. Besides, you and the Legion have the same objectives.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oh, you're so clever, Chief!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: But there's something you didn't guess right. Not only will Roulecca destroy them, but there's also something really important Roulecca needs to do.
What is it?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Roulecca will let them say it themselves: who exactly is behind them!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: After that, I will personally deliver bullets into their heads one by one, and blow out their brains with a "bang!"

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I will take revenge with my own hands!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hahahahah... Don't you think it's a little too late for that, Chief?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Didn't you desperately get me to sit here to find out about the group behind the gangs?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Our interests are aligned. Now, I just need you to be honest with me, Chief. After that, I'll help you deal with your crap so you can just relax in your office, sip some tea or read your documents!
The game is already over. That was the fifth bullet. The next one will be a live round.
Let's stop here.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: No... the game is not over yet, Chief. If Roulecca wins, you have to tell me everything you know!
What are you doing?!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I have never failed before, not in the past and definitely not now!
She turns the gun around and points it at herself.
She pulls the trigger.

Everything happens in a flash. You have no time to think, except to instinctively lunge forward to grab the gun. You "failed" but it's not so much of a failure. The bullet explodes in the cylinder, and Roulecca is grazed by the broken metal, her hands covered with blood. The alarm in the Bureau goes off.
She does have strong luck. As long as she plans on living, nothing can kill her off.
Unlike her, you get up from the floor with difficulty, the name lists on the table scattered everywhere.
Those are name lists of Black Water members. They have had contact with the gangs in the crypt that you are closely watching.
Her face is pale from the blood loss and pain, but her eyes do not move away from the lists. Her smile becomes the most unsettling at this moment.
Roulecca ignores her hand injury and, despite the blood dripping, she is able to find the list she wants from the pile.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: This is what you saw in the crypt the other day, eh?
You marvel at Roulecca's memory. She remembers it so clearly despite only seeing it once.
If you're not mistaken, her objective today is this name list.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sigh... This wouldn't have happened if you had given me the names, Chief.
They are just suspicious. Don't do anything silly.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Oh, they're suspicious? That means one of them must have sold weapons to the Syndicate gangs, right?
You cannot deny it. During this stalemate, the sound of a break-in comes from the door.
The door to the interrogation room is urgently opened from the outside. Operatives swarm in, pointing their guns at Roulecca to prevent her from making any further moves.
She is injured and doesn't pose a threat for now. Let the EMTs come in.
The EMTs then put Roulecca onto a stretcher.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Let's meet again in Syndicate, Chief.
Roulecca waves her bloodied hand at you while being carried out of the interrogation room by the EMTs.
Sorry, but I cannot play such dangerous games with you. Are there any substitute games?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ugh, you're boring. Roulecca was in such a good mood until someone named ${PlayerName} broke her heart.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Well, never mind. It just so happens that I have other things to do.
You feel an unfamiliar chill coming. From within her smiling eyes is an out-of-control madness.
From the silent interrogation room comes a regular ticking sound.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hehe, since you refused, I'll have to find some fun on my own.
Roulecca taps on the back of the chair with her left hand as if giving a signal.
You quickly try to open the control panel in the interrogation room, but a blast of air sends you tumbling on the ground.
Bang—
The wall of the interrogation room explodes from behind you and all the alarms go off. You do not understand why the Hypercube-reinforced wall is blown up so easily by Roulecca.
Nor do you understand why she did this.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Don't think too much of it, Chief! Losing to the invincible Roulecca is nothing to be ashamed of!
Despite being splattered by the debris, Roulecca is in high spirits. She proudly waves the material you had on the table and leaps down from the hole in the wall.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Goodbye, Chief. Next time we meet, you've got to entertain me more.
